The call

What happens on a Connectora demo?

A Connectora demo is a short video call with the Growthmak team. We learn your targets and how many LinkedIn accounts you run, walk through Connectora on a sample campaign, propose a safe daily sending pace for your accounts, and recommend the plan that fits. You leave with a clear plan whether or not you buy.

PartWhat we cover
1. Your goalsWho you want to reach, how many accounts, what you use today
2. Live walkthroughLead upload or Sales Navigator search, sequence, schedule, plan-ahead queue
3. Safety planA realistic daily pace per account, warm-up needs, invitation clean-up (safe daily sending pace)
4. Inbox and repliesUnibox, Hold & Resume, AI drafts, CRM webhook
5. Plan and next stepsThe right plan for your number of accounts, and how onboarding works

Length: 30 minutes

Pricing

How much does Connectora cost?

Connectora costs $24 per LinkedIn sender account per month for 1 to 2 accounts, $21 for 3 to 10, $18 for 11 to 50 and $15 for 51 or more, with lower prices on annual billing. Every plan includes every feature. On the demo we help you choose the right plan; there is no obligation to buy.

Full details: Pricing.

Prepare

What should I bring to the demo?

Bring three things to get the most from a Connectora demo: a description or sample of your target list (a Sales Navigator search URL is ideal), the number of LinkedIn accounts that will send outreach, and the tool or process you use today. With these we can show you a realistic plan for your own campaign.

Onboarding

What happens after the demo?

If Connectora is a fit, we help you connect your LinkedIn accounts, set safe limits and warm-up where needed, import your first lead list, and build your first sequence together. Your first campaign is reviewed with you before it launches.
